skill.summary: Use when building UI with shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS layouts, form patterns with react-hook-form and zod, theming, dark mode, sidebar layouts, mobile navigation, or any shadcn component question.

latestVersion.changelog:
shadcn-ui 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides expert guidance for building UIs with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, react-hook-form, and zod.
- Covers installation steps, component categories, and usage best practices.
- Includes detailed component tables for layout, navigation, data display, forms, actions, and feedback.
- Offers a complete react-hook-form + zod form pattern example using shadcn/ui components.
- Supports theming, dark mode, sidebar layouts, and mobile navigation use cases.
- Triggered by keywords like shadcn, radix, UI components, form pattern, and theming.
